shell.title: Pulsar Kids — learning games for kids
shell.description: Pulsar Kids — 50 learning games for kids aged 4–10: math, language, logic, geography, history and more. No ads, no tears, no timers.
shell.ogTitle: Pulsar Kids — learning that feels like an adventure
shell.ogDescription: Math, language, logic, geography, astronomy, history and nature in 50 games. Your child plays and builds a planet of their own, while you stay in charge of screen time.

login.title: Kids’ login — Pulsar Kids
login.description: Kids’ login to Pulsar Kids: type your nickname and the PIN your parents gave you — and set off on an adventure with math, geography and history.

parentLogin.title: Parents’ area — Pulsar Kids
parentLogin.description: Sign in to the Pulsar Kids parents’ area: add your children, set play time and family goals, and follow their progress.
